pois.name: Shibuya Scramble Crossing
pois.description: World's busiest pedestrian crossing — 2,500 people cross simultaneously every 90 seconds. Best viewed from the Starbucks terrace at the QFront building or from Scramble Square's observation deck.

pois.name: Hachiko Statue
pois.description: Bronze Akita dog who waited daily at Shibuya Station for his deceased owner from 1923 until 1935. Tokyo's most iconic meeting point, outside the Hachiko exit of the station.

pois.name: Shibuya 109
pois.description: Iconic cylindrical fashion tower opened in 1979, synonymous with gyaru culture and fast J-fashion trends. 9 floors of boutiques catering to young Tokyo streetwear.

pois.name: Center-gai
pois.description: Shibuya's main pedestrian street lined with fast-food, karaoke boxes, game centres and live music venues. Packed every night with Tokyo's youth culture.

pois.name: Shibuya Scramble Square
pois.description: Shibuya's tallest tower (230 m, 2019). The SHIBUYA SKY open-air observation deck on floor 46 gives a 360° panorama of Tokyo — Mount Fuji visible on clear winter days.
